snapshot.text: Shared governance: the Ministry of Health works with the Regions on prevention and planning. Main challenges include mental health and prevention, and the government is now implementing a 2025–2030 mental health plan and a 2026–2031 prevention plan.

priorities.title: Mental health action plan 2025–2030
priorities.text: Italy is putting its National Mental Health Action Plan 2025–2030 into practice, using a One Mental Health approach and new 2026 prevention commitments, as confirmed at a WHO Europe event in the Senate.

priorities.title: National Prevention Plan 2026–2031
priorities.text: The 2026–2031 prevention plan is delivered through the Ministry with the Regions, and part of its funding is a yearly allocation protected within the National Health Fund.

netherlands.text: A Dutch-Italian development cooperation page lists sexual and reproductive health and rights among Dutch expertise themes. It does not confirm specific joint health projects with Italy.
